# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.9 Worker 1: Eurasian AI Logic Overhaul (oe_ai2_, 0 slots). Generated by gen_v99_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Verified EU5 1.4.9 scripted_diplomatic_objectives schema.
# Complements oe_majors_ai.txt (zero key overlap). All actor triggers enforce is_ai = yes & is_rebel_country = no.

# 1. BYZ / ROM: sustain Orthodox Black Sea shield with Trebizond & Georgia
oe_ai2_byz_blacksea_orthodox_shield = {
	days_between_checks = 360

	actor_trigger = {
		oe_ai2_ai_base = yes
		OR = {
			tag = BYZ
			tag = ROM
		}
		religion = religion:orthodox
	}

	recipient_trigger = {
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				tag = TRE
				tag = GEO
			}
			religion = religion:orthodox
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			"opinion(scope:actor)" < 140
		}
	}

	recipient_priority = 45

	pause_trigger = {
		scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
	}

	cancel_trigger = {
		OR = {
			scope:actor = { is_rival_of = scope:recipient }
			scope:recipient = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
		}
	}

	improve_relation = yes
	improve_relation_limit = 140
	defensive_support = yes
	max_allowed = 2
}

	recipient_priority = 40

# 4. VEN / GEN: channel Mediterranean merchant rivalry toward each other rather than inland powers
oe_ai2_ven_gen_mediterranean_rivalry = {
	days_between_checks = 360

	actor_trigger = {
		oe_ai2_ai_base = yes
		OR = {
			tag = VEN
			tag = GEN
		}
		at_war = no
		oe_ai2_in_fiscal_crisis = no
	}

	recipient_trigger = {
		scope:recipient = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					scope:actor = { tag = VEN }
					tag = GEN
				}
				AND = {
					scope:actor = { tag = GEN }
					tag = VEN
				}
			}
			NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:actor } }
		}
	}

	recipient_priority = 35

	pause_trigger = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				oe_ai2_in_fiscal_crisis = yes
				war_exhaustion >= 6
			}
		}
	}

	cancel_trigger = {
		scope:actor = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:recipient } }
	}

	antagonise = yes
	max_allowed = 1
}

# 5. TUR: cultivate Crimean / Pontic Sunni entente once established in Anatolia
oe_ai2_tur_cri_steppe_entente = {
	days_between_checks = 360

	actor_trigger = {
		oe_ai2_ai_base = yes
		tag = TUR
		country_exists = c:CRI
		current_year >= 1420
	}

	recipient_trigger = {
		scope:recipient = {
			tag = CRI
			religion = scope:actor.religion
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			"opinion(scope:actor)" < 120
		}
	}

	recipient_priority = 40

	pause_trigger = {
		scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
	}

	cancel_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { country_exists = c:CRI }
			scope:actor = { is_rival_of = scope:recipient }
		}
	}

	improve_relation = yes
	improve_relation_limit = 120
	defensive_support = yes
	max_allowed = 1
}

# 7. Fiscal Austerity Detente: indebted AI majors soothe strong neighbors instead of provoking coalitions
oe_ai2_austerity_defensive_detente = {
	days_between_checks = 180

	actor_trigger = {
		oe_ai2_ai_base = yes
		oe_ai2_is_governed_power = yes
		oe_ai2_in_fiscal_crisis = yes
	}

	recipient_trigger = {
		scope:recipient = {
			is_neighbor_of = scope:actor
			NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			"opinion(scope:actor)" < 90
		}
	}

	recipient_priority = 65

	pause_trigger = {
		scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
	}

	cancel_trigger = {
		scope:actor = { oe_ai2_in_fiscal_crisis = no }
	}

	improve_relation = yes
	improve_relation_limit = 90
	antagonise = no
	max_allowed = 2
}

# 8. High War Exhaustion Detente: bleeding AI powers pause antagonism against neutral neighbors
oe_ai2_multifront_war_detente = {
	days_between_checks = 180

	actor_trigger = {
		oe_ai2_ai_base = yes
		oe_ai2_is_governed_power = yes
		at_war = yes
		war_exhaustion >= 6
	}

	recipient_trigger = {
		scope:recipient = {
			is_neighbor_of = scope:actor
			NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			NOT = { is_rival_of = scope:actor }
			"opinion(scope:actor)" < 60
		}
	}

	recipient_priority = 55

	pause_trigger = {
		scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient }
	}

	cancel_trigger = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
			war_exhaustion < 4
		}
	}

	improve_relation = yes
	improve_relation_limit = 60
	antagonise = no
	max_allowed = 2
}
